result.title: Inversion-Free High-Dimensional Counterfactual Inference
result.summary: Counterfactual inference is the task of answering hypothetical "what-if" queries about a unit, given an observational dataset, modeling assumptions, and a causal graph. This enables a modeler to reason about hypothetical scenarios that cannot otherwise be answered without assumptions or a causal graph. The simpler case involves a causal graph with scalar 1-D variables that denote different attributes in the data-generation process. While the literature is clear in the 1-D case, extending this to settings with high-dimensional nodes (e.g., images) remains challenging. Conventionally, in the literature, methods recover the latent state from the factual image (inversion), generate counterfactual attributes from the graph, and render the counterfactual image from the latent state using the updated attributes. In our work, we investigate the necessity of the inversion step in computing high-dimensional counterfactuals. We first discuss moving from the scalar 1-D case to the higher-dimensional case. Secondly, we discuss the relevance of the inversion step and evaluate an inversion-free counterpart repurposed from the image-editing literature. Finally, on image datasets such as CelebA and ADNI, we benchmark our approach using two measures: namely, effectiveness and identity preservation. While effectiveness is a measure of how faithfully the counterfactual attribute is rendered, identity preservation measures whether the same unit (image) is being rendered, both of which are crucial for high-dimensional counterfactual inference. We present the tradeoffs of using inversion-based and inversion-free approaches in our work.

AI.brief_summary: 研究高维（图像）反事实推断中显式反演步骤是否必要：作者讨论从标量到高维节点的推广，并借用图像编辑中的无反转方法，在 CelebA、ADNI 上用有效性与身份保持两项指标比较两类方案的取舍。
AI.relevance_reason: 「是否需要从事实图像反演隐状态」与 LVR 中推理状态如何构建、视觉内容是否被保留的问题可供核查，身份保持指标也可能用于衡量 latent 内容保真；但该文属因果推断与图像编辑，需较多迁移判断。
